summary: Frontend-only retest completed: tracked Vercel buildCommand env injection is valid in both root/frontend vercel.json, clean-copy builds without .env files succeed, built app mounts with age-gate and no Sanity-config page error; production luxsexiaiii.com still serves stale failing bundle with ErrorBoundary until redeploy.

ui_bugs.issue: https://luxsexiaiii.com renders AppErrorFallback instead of age-gate/home.

integration_issues.issue: Production console still throws 'Configuração Sanity incompleta.' from deployed chunk, confirming stale bundle not redeployed with tracked buildCommand.
gitleaks binary is unavailable in this container (command not found), so this required check could not be executed here.

action_items: Push/commit current tracked config and redeploy Vercel so production stops serving stale chunk bundle.
After redeploy, revalidate luxsexiaiii.com shows age-gate and no AppErrorFallback/Sanity-config console error.
Run gitleaks in CI or any environment where gitleaks is installed to complete mandatory security evidence.
critical_code_review_comments: Root and frontend vercel.json buildCommand inject only public Sanity identifiers (projectId/dataset/apiVersion); no token/secret found.
frontend/src/sanity/client.js fail-fast throw is correct and explains production fallback when env vars are absent at build-time.
Root-cause remains deployment state, not external Sanity Studio file overwrite.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Executed: yarn biome check PASS (deprecation info only), yarn vitest run PASS (6 files/9 tests), yarn build PASS, clean-copy build without frontend/.env and .env.production PASS using root and frontend buildCommand env injection, preview URL PASS (#root mounted + age-gate visible), production URL FAIL (AppErrorFallback visible and console error 'Configuração Sanity incompleta.').
rca of the issue: Reproduced RCA: production still serves an older frontend bundle compiled without REACT_APP_SANITY_PROJECT_ID/REACT_APP_SANITY_DATASET/REACT_APP_SANITY_API_VERSION. In that bundle, sanity/client throws during module init, which is caught by ErrorBoundary and renders AppErrorFallback. Local/preview clean builds using tracked buildCommand vars mount correctly, proving Studio overwrite is not the site failure cause.
